title: For price you cant go wrong.. a bit hodgepodge!
text:
For price you cant go wrong.. a bit hodgepodge!. Love the idea and size… Overall whimsical print and approach!! Having said that, it feels like these may have been random color remnants pulled into one hodgepodge set?! Xmas, Halloween, fall and a white to boot.. Hmm?! And at $13 you cant go wrong if you have a need for this size!

set in 1/2 orange (2 shades), teal and then white!! I suggest use variations of colors for the occasion- orange and teal for fall/Halloween- deeper orange can almost look red.. teal almost green = Xmas! And white- springtime! Hard to say what seller was after.. I think I know- it just lacks any real cohesiveness to even be random!!

Make great gift for candy or ring dish.. if separated you’ll have 8 to fill and share?!! In fact, I gave x4 orange versions for Halloween with cupcakes inside ..it was perfect! All depends on how you want to use.
Price is inline with the blemishes- I had no chips, cracks or breaks.. but, I did have “pock-marks” in the paint, see up close photos I have included. Again.. purpose/price consideration!! Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.
